segments.text: We have watched love move—seeing, giving, staying, repairing.
We have felt how one life can enter another without knowing quite why.
Those movements do not leave people unchanged; something begins to grow between them—not a theory waiting to replace what we have seen, but a relationship becoming deeper over time.
What helps those bonds endure is worth noticing—not to solve the deepest mystery, but to see what grows when a life that already matters becomes more fully real.
